title: The 5-Second Trick Banks Don't Explain
description:
Want to know how fast your money doubles? Divide 72 by the yearly interest rate. That's it.

The rule of 72 works for savings, investments and even debt, and it shows why a few percent makes a huge difference over time.

Educational content only, not financial advice.

#money #personalfinance #investing

scenes.narration: Here is a five second trick to see how fast your money doubles.
Take the number seventy two and divide it by your yearly interest rate.
At two percent, your money doubles in about thirty six years. At eight percent, in about nine.
That is why a few percent matters so much. It is the difference between doubling twice and doubling eight times in a lifetime.
And it works against you too. A credit card at twenty four percent doubles what you owe in about three years.
So remember seventy two. It tells you whether time is working for you, or against you.
